scientific_integrity: Complete analytical proof of an explicit parameter-indexed statistical theorem with supplemental exact finite checks. The older conjugate map and its known q=2 results are acknowledged, and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the integer postcritical parameter slice q>=3, both branches of the planar map have zero determinant; stationary CLT and pressure concern its compact interval, not all planar initial distributions; unresolved historical priority regarding general symbolic-renewal results.
title: Exact renewal pressure and entropy separation in a degenerate border-collision map
